title: Spec 006 Contract Resolution Table
notes: This table resolves conflicting contract statements without silently widening production behavior.
Unresolved migration work remains blocked for release closure until its acceptance-impact rows are executed.

entries.decision: Canonical simulation scope prefix is sim-{runId}. runId is a bare identifier; scope helper adds sim- exactly once.
entries.migration: Update spec/docs references from sim_{...} to sim-{...}; route all simulation scope creation through simulation_scope helper.
acceptanceImpact: SC-009 simulation/live isolation assertions must use sim-{runId}.
Any test fixtures with sim_ must be updated or explicitly marked legacy.

entries.decision: Canonical envelope provenance field is simulationRunId (camelCase) in v1 schema.
entries.migration: Correct spec prose and plan/research references that still use simulation_run_id.
acceptanceImpact: Schema validation checks must use provenance.simulationRunId.
Generated simulation signals must carry simulationRunId when collectionMethod is simulation.

entries.decision: packages/schemas/signal-envelope.schema.json v1 remains the authoritative production ingestion contract for spec006. v2 is experimental and scoped to spec036 only.

chosenContract.productionLoader: apps/ingestion/worker.py loads only v1 schema id https://example.gov.au/schemas/signal-envelope.schema.json

entries.migration: Mark v2 as experimental/spec036-only and require explicit migration planning before any production adoption.
acceptanceImpact: Production schema loader must fail closed on non-v1 schema id.
Spec036 simulation extension must use allowed v1 fields or declare an explicit future migration gate.

entries.decision: Spec006 scenario/run contract remains a compatibility API delegated to current 007 simulation services/models. It is not a rival state machine.

chosenContract.resolution: compatibility facade over current simulation service

entries.migration: Keep one canonical simulation state machine implementation and map 006 contract fields through a compatibility layer.
acceptanceImpact: Contract tests must hit real HTTP routes, not hand-built dictionaries.
Compatibility notes must accompany max behavioral differences until facade lands.

entries.decision: HPK casing is scope / jurisdictionId / dataSourceId; time field remains occurred_at in stored document index compatibility.
entries.migration: Maintain camelCase HPK key fields in persisted documents and keep index-compatible occurred_at field naming without Bicep edits in this task.
acceptanceImpact: Repository document serialization must always emit scope, jurisdictionId, dataSourceId.
Static tests enforce HPK key presence and schema authority decisions.
